description_en: Retrieve column information for a specified table in the current workspace
description_zh: 获取当前指定业务空间，指定表下面的列信息
name: ListColumn

parameters.help_en: ID of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace used for this request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的阿里云百炼业务空间id
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: Maximum number of entries per page
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Paging token

Omit this parameter for the first call

For subsequent calls, use the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
分页游标。

如果是首次调用，该参数不传。

如果是非首次调用，该参数传上传调用时返回的nextToken
parameters.name: next_token
